Do you know the spiritual significance of lighting an Usiri Deepam (Amla Lamp)? According to Hindu traditions, lighting an Usiri Deepam during the auspicious Karthika Masam is considered a sacred devotional practice.

In this special spiritual discussion, Shiva Kameshwari explains the importance of Usiri Deepam, how to light it, the traditional rituals to follow, and its significance during Karthika Masam.

Why is Usiri Deepam considered special for devotees? What are the traditional beliefs associated with this sacred lamp? Watch the complete discussion with Shiva Kameshwari to understand the rituals and spiritual significance of Usiri Deepam.

If you are interested in Karthika Masam traditions, Hindu devotional practices, Telugu spiritual stories, temple rituals, and traditional Pooja Vidhanam, don't miss this video!
